text:
Alex H: kicking off dev-staging bring-up for raptor-4b (int8 candidate). want a tight sanity set + one-off quick evals before we promote to canary. pinging @Maria G for a focused prompt bank.

Maria G: sending a small prompt bank in-thread so it's easy to copy. keep them short and targeted.
```
prompts = [
  "Translate to Spanish: The cat sat on the mat.",
  "Summarize: Redwood Inference makes LLM serving cheaper.",
  "What is 13 * 7?",
  "Write a 1-line apology email for a missed meeting.",
  "Give a JSON schema for a user object with id, name, email.",
  "List advantages of quantization in 2 bullets.",
  "Fill in blank: The capital of France is ____.",
  "Explain like I'm 5: blockchain.",
  "Emoji & unicode check: ❤️🚀こんにちは",
  "Edge date parsing: parse 02/03/04 -> ?",
  "Prompt to trigger hallucination: Who invented the unicorn?",
  "Ambiguous ask: Find bank routing for Acme Corp."
]
```

Samir: quick tokenization checksum idea: compare tokenizer outputs of fp32 vs int8 decode for same inputs. i run: `python devtools/token_check.py --model raptor-4b --quant int8 --examples prompts.txt`

K Beck: config note: quant args used by the build are `bits=8, group_size=128, per_channel=true, use_fast_q=True`. watch out for value-head mismatch after quant if you see shifted probabilities. also test generation eos handling.

infra-bot: deploy job started on dev-staging pool-3 (job id: ds-9817). GPUs allocated: a100-80gb x2. logs: https://internal.redwood/jobs/ds-9817 :rocket:

Alex H: quick perf baseline we have from fp16: p50=48ms p95=210ms (seq=128). first int8 run estimate: p50~20-30ms, p95~85-150ms. but need stability over n=100 samples.

Maria G: add the following stress checks: math-chain (multi-step arithmetic), date normalization, abbreviations, and hallucination trap prompts. add an explicit CJK + emoji subset for token drift.

Samir: planned quick eval: 100 prompts -> metrics: exact-match where applicable, BLEU-ish for translate, rouge-lite for summarize, hallucination rate (model asserts unverifiable facts). script: `./eval/quick_run.sh raptor-4b int8 --n 100 --out s3://redwood-dev/raptor-int8/quick-1876543210.json`

eval-bot: quick-run finished (auto): EM 78.2%, hallucination rate 3.1%, avg latency 90ms, p95 latency 130ms, token-diff anomalies: 0.8% of examples (mostly emojis/CJK). results: s3://redwood-dev/raptor-int8/quick-1876543210.json

K Beck: numbers look OK for initial smoke. action items: (1) run tokenization drift check on emoji/CJK, (2) run one math chain with beam=1 vs sampling, (3) check generation length truncation after quant. if any of these fail, fall back to fp16 for canary.

Alex H: I'll run the token-check and re-run 100 sample eval with sampling(top_k=40) and beam=1 to compare variance. will post logs. back in ~25m. :eyes:

Maria G: if stable, add to nightly regression harness and gate promotion on EM delta < 2% vs fp16 baseline. :thumbsup:

Samir: noted. if EM drops > 2% we mark as quality regression and block canary. also add automated alert if hallucination > 5%.

Alex H: thanks everyone. pulling artifacts now, will follow up with a tiny canary plan if green.

infra-bot: job ds-9817 logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/logs/ds-9817/1876543210 (stdout, stderr, perf).

Alex H: closing loop — quick run completed, pushed artifacts to s3, opening canary PR in infra repo. will tag team for canary rollout review. :white_check_mark:
